I think every theme is based on Foundation. It’s how a forum looks by default. There is no need for your theme to change a button color that already looks like it should by default. These defaults change now, which is why it affects all themes - even the Horizon theme is affected:
You can see that the header is thinner, the chat icon is darker, and the button is no longer filled.
